name: Fever
note: Fireballs GC partner (logo links to feverup.com, verified in the livgolf.com/fireballs-gc HTML, 2026-10-03). On livgolf.com/partners Fever is listed among LIV Golf's Official Suppliers: 'As a Marketing & Technology Partner, Fever powers the LIV Golf ticketing journey' (verified 2026-10-03). Unrated: Fever's releases describe it as co-founded and led by Ignacio Bachiller, Francisco Hein and Alexandre Perez, but its September 2026 $250 million round (led by EQT, with Point72 Private Investments, Baillie Gifford and other existing investors participating) names no controlling shareholder; who holds a controlling share is not identified (fever-founders-ownership). No state or state fund appears among the investors named in its releases; no human-rights finding against the company found.
